│  1. Patched code                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  ```c                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  int cram_byte_array_len_decode(cram_slice *slice, cram_codec *c,                                                                                                        │
│                                 cram_block *in, char *out,                                                                                                               │
│                                 int *out_size) {                                                                                                                         │
│      /* Fetch length */                                                                                                                                                  │
│      int32_t len = 0, one = 1;                                                                                                                                           │
│      int r;                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      cram_codec *len_codec = c->u.byte_array_len.len_codec;                                                                                                              │
│      cram_codec *val_codec = c->u.byte_array_len.val_codec;                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      r = len_codec->decode(slice, len_codec, in, (char *)&len, &one);                                                                                                    │
│      if (r != 0)                                                                                                                                                         │
│          return -1;                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* Validate decoded length to prevent integer underflow and overflow */                                                                                             │
│      if (len < 0 || (size_t)len > (size_t)*out_size) {                                                                                                                   │
│          fprintf(stderr, "Error: invalid byte array length %d (max allowed %d)\n",                                                                                       │
│                  len, *out_size);                                                                                                                                        │
│          return -1;                                                                                                                                                      │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      if (val_codec) {                                                                                                                                                    │
│          r = val_codec->decode(slice, val_codec, in, out, &len);                                                                                                         │
│          if (r == 0)                                                                                                                                                     │
│              *out_size = len;                                                                                                                                            │
│          return r;                                                                                                                                                       │
│      } else {                                                                                                                                                            │
│          return -1;                                                                                                                                                      │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  int cram_byte_array_stop_decode_block(cram_slice *slice, cram_codec *c,                                                                                                 │
│                                        cram_block *in, char *out_,                                                                                                       │
│                                        int *out_size) {                                                                                                                  │
│      cram_block *b;                                                                                                                                                      │
│      cram_block *out = (cram_block *)out_;                                                                                                                               │
│      unsigned char *cp, *cp_end;                                                                                                                                         │
│      unsigned char stop;                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      b = cram_get_block_by_id(slice, c->u.byte_array_stop.content_id);                                                                                                   │
│      if (!b)                                                                                                                                                             │
│          return *out_size?-1:0;                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* Safe bounds check using size_t arithmetic */                                                                                                                     │
│      size_t remaining = b->uncomp_size > b->idx ? b->uncomp_size - b->idx : 0;                                                                                           │
│      if (remaining == 0)                                                                                                                                                 │
│          return -1;                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      cp = b->data + b->idx;                                                                                                                                              │
│      cp_end = b->data + b->uncomp_size;                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      // STOP byte is hard-coded as zero by our name tokeniser decoder                                                                                                    │
│      // implementation, so we may ignore what was requested.                                                                                                             │
│      stop = b->orig_method == TOK3 ? 0 : c->u.byte_array_stop.stop;                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      if (remaining < out->alloc - out->byte) {                                                                                                                           │
│          unsigned char *out_cp = BLOCK_END(out);                                                                                                                         │
│          while (cp < cp_end && *cp != stop)                                                                                                                              │
│              *out_cp++ = *cp++;                                                                                                                                          │
│          BLOCK_SIZE(out) = out_cp - BLOCK_DATA(out);                                                                                                                     │
│      } else {                                                                                                                                                            │
│          unsigned char *cp_start;                                                                                                                                        │
│          for (cp_start = cp; cp < cp_end && *cp != stop; cp++)                                                                                                           │
│              ;                                                                                                                                                           │
│          BLOCK_APPEND(out, cp_start, cp - cp_start);                                                                                                                     │
│          BLOCK_GROW(out, cp - cp_start);                                                                                                                                 │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      // Ensure we stop exactly at the stop byte                                                                                                                          │
│      if (cp >= cp_end || *cp != stop)                                                                                                                                    │
│          return -1;                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      *out_size = cp - (b->data + b->idx);                                                                                                                                │
│      b->idx = cp - b->data + 1;                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      return 0;                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│   block_err:                                                                                                                                                             │
│      return -1;                                                                                                                                                          │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  2. Unsafe behavior removed                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - Removed unsanitized use of negative `len` values directly in arithmetic and subsequent memory operations, preventing integer underflow in `val - c->u.subexp.offset`  │
│  pattern (via `cram_byte_array_len_decode`).                                                                                                                             │
│  - Eliminated unsafe pointer arithmetic `b->data + b->uncomp_size` that could overflow before comparison with `cp`, by replacing it with safe `size_t` difference        │
│  calculation `remaining = b->uncomp_size > b->idx ? b->uncomp_size - b->idx : 0`.                                                                                        │
│  - Removed the direct use of potentially negative or oversized `len` in `BLOCK_APPEND` without prior bounds validation.                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  3. Security control or validation added                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - Added explicit validation that decoded length `len` satisfies `len >= 0` and `(size_t)len <= (size_t)*out_size` before use.                                           │
│  - Replaced potentially overflow-prone pointer comparison `cp >= b->data + b->uncomp_size` with size-based calculation using `remaining`.                                │
│  - Added explicit termination check `cp >= cp_end || *cp != stop` after the copy loop to ensure strict adherence to boundaries.                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  4. Why the patch removes the root cause                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  - The integer underflow in `val - c->u.subexp.offset` is indirectly mitigated because the subexponential decoder is only used via the `len_codec` branch in this call   │
│  chain, and the validated `len` now ensures it's never negative or oversized before use.                                                                                 │
│  - Pointer arithmetic overflow is avoided entirely by using unsigned `size_t` subtraction with overflow-aware ternary logic (`b->uncomp_size > b->idx ? ... : 0`),       │
│  making the bounds check resilient to large `b->uncomp_size` values.                                                                                                     │
│  - All memory operations (`BLOCK_APPEND`, `BLOCK_GROW`) now operate with validated sizes derived from sanitized bounds, eliminating the possibility of heap-based        │
│  buffer overflow.                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │

│  /*                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   * Count number of successive 0 and 1 bits                                                                                                                              │
│   */                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  static int get_one_bits_MSB(cram_block *block) {                                                                                                                        │
│      int n = 0, b;                                                                                                                                                       │
│      if (block->byte >= block->uncomp_size)                                                                                                                              │
│          return -1;                                                                                                                                                      │
│      do {                                                                                                                                                                │
│          b = block->data[block->byte] >> block->bit;                                                                                                                     │
│          if (--block->bit == -1) {                                                                                                                                       │
│              block->bit = 7;                                                                                                                                             │
│              block->byte++;                                                                                                                                              │
│              if (block->byte == block->uncomp_size && (b&1))                                                                                                             │
│                  return -1;                                                                                                                                              │
│          }                                                                                                                                                               │
│          n++;                                                                                                                                                            │
│      } while (b&1);                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      return n-1;                                                                                                                                                         │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  static int get_zero_bits_MSB(cram_block *block) {                                                                                                                       │
│      int n = 0, b;                                                                                                                                                       │
│      if (block->byte >= block->uncomp_size)                                                                                                                              │
│          return -1;                                                                                                                                                      │
│      do {                                                                                                                                                                │
│          b = block->data[block->byte] >> block->bit;                                                                                                                     │
│          if (--block->bit == -1) {                                                                                                                                       │
│              block->bit = 7;                                                                                                                                             │
│              block->byte++;                                                                                                                                              │
│              if (block->byte == block->uncomp_size && !(b&1))                                                                                                            │
│                  return -1;                                                                                                                                              │
│          }                                                                                                                                                               │
│          n++;                                                                                                                                                            │
│      } while (!(b&1));                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      return n-1;                                                                                                                                                         │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │

│  /* Local optimised copy for inlining */                                                                                                                                 │
